stated_limitation: The Buddy session is not a failure of the pipeline so much as a limit on its statistical power: its units fire sparsely while running (median 58 spikes per unit-direction against 108 for Achilles), and with that few spikes the circular-shift null is broad enough that genuinely tuned cells cannot clear the 99th percentile.

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 (Grosmark & Buzsáki dorsal CA1 linear-track) is the canonical known-good dataset for place cells, theta, and precession.
justification.handling: Real files streamed via remfile with byte-range reads, excitatory units selected, speed-thresholded directional passes, circular-maze sessions correctly detected and excluded and reported.
justification.analysis: Skaggs information against a 500-fold circular-shift null, split-half stability, cross-validated naive-Bayes decoding, and Kempter circular-linear correlation with proper circular statistics for precession, all standard and correct.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (141/462 fields, 104/231 units, SI 1.10 vs 0.50, width 0.20 m, decode 0.092 vs 0.447 m, precession n=31 rho=-0.23 slope=-0.56, Wilcoxon W=51 p=1.6e-5) reproduces exactly from the committed CSVs.
justification.figures: All eight figures are publication-grade: labeled axes with units, sample sizes, representative examples, clear population summaries showing the diagonal tiling, decoding posteriors, and the precession rho distribution.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate and the write-up names specific limitations (the low-yield Buddy session, the testable-subset re-count, the 2 significantly-positive precession fields, chance baselines), misrepresenting nothing shown in its own figures.
